resources.string: "Let's check your financial condition this month! "
"Your finances are very stable! You manage your expenses and savings very well. "
"Your finances are quite stable, but you can still save more! "
"Your spending is quite high, you should start controlling it! "
"Your expenses exceed your income! Warning, your financial condition is not healthy. "

MoneyCheck is a simple mobile application designed to help users evaluate their monthly financial condition. Users can input their income, expenses, and savings (if any), and the app will automatically calculate the remaining balance and determine the financial category. This application is designed with a simple and user-friendly interface for everyday use. Financial categories are determined based on the percentage of remaining money compared to income. If ≥ 70%, it is considered very stable; 50%–69% is fairly stable; 0%–49% is considered wasteful; and if the remaining money ≤ 0, it is considered very wasteful.
